_about: Every public-domain Horatius Bonar (1808-1889, Kelso and Edinburgh) PROSE text the Word Hoard holds. His hymns and poems belong to Adam's separate hymn manifest and are listed only as 'see hymn manifest'. All items are lifetime printings except where marked. Not Andrew A. Bonar (his brother, own shelf), not James Bonar (economist), not J. B. Bonar.
